review_scope: Read-only examination of main-branch safety_foundation, MASTER_SPEC, reconciliation and confirmed Q116-Q122 owner reviews. Checks interaction of adopted policies, not completed numerical implementations.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Every candidate new order must pass individual 0.5% equity and combined 1.0% equity maximum estimated stop-loss exposure tests, counting open positions, pending orders and the candidate. Calculation unavailable or limits breached means reject new order.
crosswalk.remaining: Define time-consistent equity snapshot, account- and pair-specific value/pip and JPY conversion, spreads/fees/slippage assumptions, concurrent order reservations, portfolio offsets, partial fills, broker minimum size, server SL confidence. Gap/slippage can exceed estimates.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Daily loss numerator follows NY17:00 start-to-current equity change corrected for external cash flows and independently reconciled with trade P/L and charges; 1.5% loss limit denominator is start-of-day equity frozen until next NY17:00 boundary, regardless of intraday profit/loss or deposits/withdrawals.
crosswalk.remaining: Define net cash-flow cutoffs, missing opening equity, profit/loss offsetting, account resets, boundary DST and holidays, missing swap/fees, rounding and disagreement fail-closed transitions.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Unitized equity adjusts virtual units for external capital moves; DD is tracked relative to unit-value high water. DD2/3 monitoring can clear only after strictly below 1.5/2.5% respectively for valid continuous 30-minute observation plus safety checks. DD4/5 new-order-stop latch needs explicit human approval regardless of temporary DD recovery; DD5 also retains liquidation attempts and incident analysis.
crosswalk.remaining: Specify unit issuance/redemption and HWM precision, valuation and fresh prices, account resets, exact state machine, simultaneous levels, recovery audit and the full adopted clock/watchdog conditions without inferring from headline values.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Q80 strategy/performance deterioration LEVEL 1/2/3 are not by definition identical to DD2/3/4 thresholds, nor communication L1/L2/L3. LEVEL 1 requires cause resolution, LEVEL 2 AI reevaluation and safety checks, LEVEL 3 safety checks plus explicit human clearance. Clearing performance monitor never clears independent DD4/5 or network stops.
crosswalk.remaining: Formal identifiers and event taxonomy; map observations to latches only after original-scope validation, decide what safely counts as cause resolved and confirm approval audit identity.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Daily-stop next-trading-day conditional automatic safety recovery and network recovery do not remove DD4/5, performance LEVEL 3, communication serious-fault or isolation-failure human-approval latches. Restart retains all stop reasons and unknown stop state prohibits new orders.
crosswalk.remaining: Canonical stop-reason IDs, persistence and atomic updates, approval authentication/expiry, reboot reconciliation, account-vs-strategy scope, race-free simultaneous trigger/clear events.

crosswalk.binding_interpretation: Q120 allows conditional repeat of close-out attempts only after independent broker/order/position/SL state reconciliation proves no duplicate or reversal risk. Q195-Q199 order identification, pre-dispatch durable state and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rules prohibit any blind resend or new orders while effects may already have occurred. A new attempt ID does not itself authorize repeating a logical operation.
crosswalk.remaining: Precise broker response-to-state mapping, retry eligibility and idempotency proofs, partial fill/reversal handling, timeout bounds, crash recovery, failure-to-close fallback, same-logical-ID attempt linkage and human intervention.

review_findings.claim_limit: No direct policy-level incompatibility was identified among the selected summaries under the stated conjunctive conditions. This is not proof of exhaustive original context, mathematical correctness or runtime safety.
